$comment: Fixture catalog for test/sync-rule-tables.test.mjs. Not a real shard: these rules exist only to exercise the rule-table generator, and are never loaded from the repository's own rules/ directory.

rules.description: Fixture rule cited by R1 of fixture Standard 90.
rules.rationale: Gives the generator a required, exemptible row.

rules.title: Fixture: spend raises an alert
rules.description: Fixture rule cited by R3 of fixture Standard 90, earlier in the shard than the other R3 rule.

rules.title: Fixture: no unbounded loop

rules.title: Fixture: a rule for a different standard
